contract.purpose: Provide the imported Reasonix CLI, loop, dashboard, tool host, MCP bridge, hooks, sessions, memory, and edit-gate baseline for MAGRA.
contract.scope: Import and preserve DeepSeek-Reasonix behavior before integrating MyGRACE, RTK, and SNARC features.

interfaces.interface-2: Dashboard API router, SSE protocol, Composer, Slash registry, and DashboardContext remain extension points.
interfaces.interface-3: ToolRegistry, CacheFirstLoop, HookRunner, SkillStore, and MCP bridge remain compatible integration seams.

acceptance.criterion-1: Reasonix baseline tests, typecheck, lint, build, and dashboard build pass before feature integration.
acceptance.criterion-2: No MyGRACE, RTK, or SNARC integration removes existing Reasonix public behavior without explicit contract change.
